info.title: Default module
info.description:
Order & Payment API (Laravel 13, JWT). See README.md for the design.

**Quick start**
1. Select the *Order Management – Local* environment (or edit the collection variables).
2. Authentication → **Login** (seeded `0096512345678` / `12345678`) saves `token`.
3. Orders → **Create Order** (saves `order_id`).
4. Payments → **Process Payment** (saves `payment_id`, `payment_reference`, `payment_amount`). A successful payment confirms the order.
5. Webhooks → set `webhook_secret` to `CREDIT_CARD_WEBHOOK_SECRET` and send events for `{{payment_reference}}`.

**Envelope**: success is `{status: true, message, data, [pagination]}`; error is `{status: false, message, errors}`. `errors` is the field map for validation errors, otherwise `null`.

**Headers**: every request sends `Accept: application/json` and `Accept-Language: {{locale}}` (`en` | `ar`). For authenticated requests, the user's stored `preferred_language` overrides the header. The seeded user prefers `ar`; use Authentication → Set Language.

get.description:
Paginated orders of the current user, with items and user.

| Query | Values |
|---|---|
| `filter[status]` | `pending` \| `confirmed` \| `cancelled` |
| `sort` | `id`, `created_at`, `total_amount` (prefix `-` for desc). Default `-id` |
| `per_page` | default 15, max 100 (values < 1 fall back to 15) |
| `page` | page number |

Unknown filters or sorts answer **400**.

example.message: Orders retrieved successfully
Requested filter(s) `user_id` are not allowed. Allowed filter(s) are `status`.
Unauthenticated. Please log in and try again.

post.description:
Creates a `pending` order. **The test script saves `order_id`.**

| Field | Rules |
|---|---|
| items | required, array, 1–100 entries |
| items.*.product_name | required, string, max 255 |
| items.*.quantity | required, integer, 1–10000 |
| items.*.price | required, numeric, max 2 decimals, 0.01–999999.99 |

Each item may only contain these three keys. The order total may not exceed 99,999,999.99.

example.message: Order created successfully
Unauthenticated. Please log in and try again.
The quantity must be at least 1.

items.0.quantity: The quantity must be at least 1.
items.0.price: The price may have at most 2 decimal places.

get.description:
One order of the current user, with items, user and its `payments` (newest first). Missing or not owned → 404.

There is no separate `GET /orders/{id}/payments`; this response carries the order's payments.

example.message: Order retrieved successfully
The requested resource was not found.

put.description: PUT and PATCH behave the same (every field optional). Sending `items` **replaces** all items and recomputes the total. This is allowed only while the order is `pending`; once a payment has confirmed it, the answer is **409**.

example.message: Order updated successfully
Order items can only be changed while the order is pending.
The order must contain at least one item.

items: The order must contain at least one item.

patch.description:
The only status a client can set. It moves a `pending` order to `cancelled`.

- Refused with **409** when the order is paid, or has a `pending` payment that could still succeed.
- Sending `status: confirmed` answers **422**, because only a successful payment confirms an order.
- Re-sending `cancelled` on a cancelled order is a no-op.

example.message: Order updated successfully
An order that is paid or has a payment in progress cannot be cancelled.
You can only cancel the order; it is confirmed by a successful payment.

status: You can only cancel the order; it is confirmed by a successful payment.

delete.description: Deletes the order and its items. Orders with **any** payment are kept: **409**.

example.message: Order deleted successfully
The requested resource was not found.
This order has payments and cannot be deleted.

post.description:
Pays a **pending** order. **The test script saves `payment_id`, `payment_reference`, `payment_amount` and `currency`** for the webhook requests.

| Field | Rules |
|---|---|
| payment_method | required, a key of `config/payment.php` gateways: `credit_card`, `paypal` |

The order row is locked, then a `pending` payment is created with a ULID `reference`. The gateway is called **outside** the transaction, and the result is applied under a lock on the payment.

- **201** `successful` → the order becomes `confirmed` and `paid_at` is set.
- **201** `failed` ("Payment failed") → the order stays `pending`; the client can pay again.
- **202** `pending` → the gateway timed out. The card may have been charged, so the payment is not failed and not re-charged. Only the webhook settles it; until then it blocks a new payment and cancellation.

Errors: 401; 404 order missing or not owned; 409 order already confirmed/paid or a payment is pending (this also stops a double submit); 422 order cancelled ("Only pending orders can be paid") or invalid method.

Simulate outcomes with `CREDIT_CARD_SIMULATE` / `PAYPAL_SIMULATE` = `success` | `fail` | `timeout` (run `php artisan config:clear` if config is cached).

example.message: Payment processed successfully
Payment is being processed. Its final status will be confirmed shortly.
Unauthenticated. Please log in and try again.
The requested resource was not found.
This order has already been paid.
Only pending orders can be paid.

post.description:
Called by the payment gateway (no JWT). Body: `{reference, status: successful|failed, amount, currency, gateway_reference?}`.

`X-Signature` = hex HMAC-SHA256 of the raw body with `<GATEWAY>_WEBHOOK_SECRET`.

200 applied (a duplicate or late event is a no-op) · 401 bad signature · 404 unknown gateway or reference (the gateway retries) · 422 invalid payload or amount/currency mismatch.

parameters.name: gateway
parameters.description: Gateway key from config/payment.php (`credit_card` | `paypal`). Unknown key → 404.
